g.text: A and B use the same monomial rows; display bins combine 4 rows × 1 column. C shows individual exact nonzeros.

g.text: Rebuilding removes vanished parameter × correction columns, then eliminates corrections again; substitution alone can miss equations.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b94d42

g.text: Ranks count finite-degree spans, not solutions. The final closure uses the earlier 25-parameter proof; all 55 correction types are retained.
